title: DAY 17/90
GEAR TRAINS
scenes.sub: Cams and gears: turn motion into marks
scenes.voice: Day seventeen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge. Ninety two days left. Today we shift gears, literally: cams, gears and gear trains.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is theory of machines. Our topic: cams and followers, gears, and simple, compound and epicyclic gear trains.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover follower motions like S H M and uniform acceleration, the law of gearing, interference and minimum teeth, and epicyclic trains.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. For an epicyclic train, subtract the arm speed first. Then the train value is the product of driver teeth over driven teeth, with the right sign.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Solve the free practice PDF on Telegram first. Then take tonight's test, seven to nine P. M., in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 16 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day sixteen toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo tops the flywheel test with twenty one point three three. Sagar takes rank two. Sai Avinash and Megha share rank three. Brilliant!
